nodes.title: Execution Profile Router
nodes.description: Select standard integration path or extended verification path based on change scope.
nodes.planningRationale: Avoids unnecessary latency for standard changes while routing complex diffs through extended hardening.

nodes.title: Standard Integration & Docs
nodes.description: Wire cross-module interfaces and finalize runtime wiring.
nodes.planningRationale: Fast integration branch when extended hardening path is not triggered.

nodes.title: Extended Contract & Stress Pass
nodes.description: Deep edge-case and resilience checks before Phase 3 certification.
nodes.planningRationale: Explicit alternate conditional branch selectable during risk-heavy iterations.

nodes.title: Security & Guardrail Scan
nodes.description: Verify constitution compliance, path confinement, and auth boundaries across all Phase 2 diffs.
nodes.planningRationale: Enabled by workflow template customization to enforce pre-merge security posture.

nodes.title: Phase 2 Join Barrier
nodes.description: Synchronize parallel PM slices and routed branches into unified verification snapshot.
nodes.planningRationale: Guarantees no verification gate executes against partially completed slices.

nodes.title: Phase 2 集成物理检查点
nodes.description: Commit integrated Phase 2 parallel worker diffs into a clean Git checkpoint prior to Phase 3 verification.
nodes.planningRationale: Separates worker implementation state from Phase 3 shell gates and rewind boundaries.

nodes.title: Deterministic Shell Gate
nodes.description: Run verification command: node --test
nodes.planningRationale: Objective exit-code gate prevents self-grading before QA review.

nodes.title: Diff, AC & DDD Drift Check
nodes.description: Inspect git diff, verify AC coverage, and check DDD ubiquitous terminology alignment.
nodes.planningRationale: Catches terminology drift and incomplete acceptance evidence early.

nodes.title: Independent QA Audit
nodes.description: Evaluate deliverable strictly against GoalSpec constraints and acceptance criteria.
nodes.planningRationale: Independent evaluator verdict separates pass commit checkpoint from bounded fail-rewind.

nodes.title: Physical Git Checkpoint
nodes.description: Commit certified worktree state and tag durable snapshot.
nodes.planningRationale: Persists recoverable milestone snapshot on verified pass.

nodes.title: Bounded Rescue Rewind
nodes.description: Create non-destructive git rescue ref and rewind execution frontier on failure.
nodes.planningRationale: Preserves debug artifacts in rescue branch while deterministically retrying up to maxReworkIterations.

nodes.title: Certified Release Complete
nodes.description: All gates, constraints, and acceptance criteria satisfied.
nodes.planningRationale: Terminal sink asserting full specification closure.
nodes.outputContract: stdout 非空行数或 stderr 错误
